parameters.query:
SELECT 
    p.risk_level,
    COUNT(*) AS total_clientes,
    ROUND(SUM(c.monthly_charges), 2) AS ingresos_totales,
    ROUND(SUM(c.monthly_charges * p.churn_probability), 2) AS perdida_esperada
FROM predicciones_churn p
JOIN clientes_raw c USING (customer_id)
GROUP BY p.risk_level
ORDER BY 
    CASE p.risk_level 
        WHEN 'Alto' THEN 1 
        WHEN 'Medio' THEN 2 
        ELSE 3 
    END;
